value.title: Coder
value.line: Builds one workstream step, then is compacted.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: Builds one step: reads the packet, writes the plan, changes the code, runs the repo's gates and opens or updates one PR.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: Compacted after every job. Its size matters more than what it remembers, so what it learned goes into a memory note before compaction.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: A memory note per job: what it built, what surprised it, what it would warn the next coder about.

value.text: Is compacted after every job, after writing its memory note.
Builds one step at a time, in its own worktree and branch.
